name: PVP Sword Fighting ⚔️🔥
desc:
The objective is simple: kill other players to steal their time; be the person with the highest time & kills. watch out for other players, they could steal your time & kills!

Rules can be found in the community server! We reserve the right to ban you for any reason.  Big UGC's will result in a kick based on moderator discretion. 

We have a one-time appeal policy so if you were banned and would like to appeal, make an appeal and be sincere! Join the community server below!

You may get trolled

Enjoy!
